packs.name: CPIC
packs.description: Gene–drug evidence levels and published guideline links where available, without inferring diplotypes or prescribing advice.
packs.attribution: Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium (CPIC), Stanford University and St. Jude Children's Research Hospital. Converted gene–drug reference data. Guidelines and content are subject to updates; consult the linked current guideline. No endorsement is implied.
packs.coverage: Complete paginated public CPIC pair_view gene-drug evidence metadata fetched 2026-09-07 (574 pairs). Some pairs do not have prescribing guidelines; real guideline links are retained when supplied. No diplotypes or prescribing rules are applied.
